content: We have carbon NMR shifts list. Need number of methyl groups (CH3). Methyl carbons typically appear around 10-30 ppm (alkyl). In list we have shifts: 88.85, 69.70, 68.60, 67.50, 31.31, 28.70, 27.60, 22.65, 18.60, 14.05. The low-field ones: 31.31, 28.70, 27.60, 22.65, 18.60, 14.05. Among these, methyl carbons are usually ~10-30 ppm, but also some could be methylene (CH2) around 20-40. Need to determine which are methyl. Could use proton NMR to see number of methyl signals. Let's get proton NMR.
